name: Kris Krüg
abstract_title: Quantum Aesthetic Judgment Framework: A Novel Approach to AI Consciousness Detection
abstract: Taste is usually framed as pattern recognition over learned features. I propose a different mechanism: aesthetic judgment as quantum-structured process whose felt qualities emerge at collapse, not computation. Building on Orch-OR, the project tests whether moments of "felt clarity" align with non-classical timing and anesthesia-sensitive microtubule dynamics, and whether context acts as decoherence field shaping collapse outcomes across neural, bodily, and cultural scales.
